Title: Characterization of Paracompactness in T3 Space/Lemma 17

Let $X$ be a [[Definition:Set|set]] with [[Definition:Well-Ordering|well-ordering]] $\preccurlyeq$ on $X$.

Let $X \times X$ denote the [[Definition:Cartesian Product|cartesian product]] of $X$ with itself.

Let $\sequence{V_n}_{n \in \N}$ be a [[Definition:Sequence|sequence]] of [[Definition:Subset|subsets]] of $X \times X$ [[Definition:Subset|containing]] the [[Definition:Diagonal Relation|diagonal $\Delta_X$]] of $X \times X$:
:$\forall n \in \N_{> 0}, V_n$ is [[Definition:Symmetric Relation|symmetric]] as a [[Definition:Relation as Subset of Cartesian Product|relation]] on $X \times X$
:$\forall n \in \N_{> 0}$, the [[Definition:Composite Relation|composite relation]] $V_n \circ V_n$ is a [[Definition:Subset|subset]] of $V_{n - 1}$, that is, $V_n \circ V_n \subseteq V_{n - 1}$

For all $n \in \N_{> 0}$, let:
:$U_n = V_n \circ V_{n - 1}, \circ \cdots \circ V_1$

For each $n \in \N_{> 0}, x \in X$, let:
:$\map {A_n} x = \map {U_n} x \setminus \ds \bigcup_{y \preccurlyeq x, y \ne x} \map {U_{n + 1}} y$

For each $n \in \N_{> 0}$, let:
:$\AA_n = \set{\map {A_n} x : x \in X}$

Then:

:$\forall n \in \N_{> 0} : \AA_n$ is a [[Definition:Discrete Set of Subsets|discrete set of subsets]].
